purpose: sustained human-AI companion interaction: unprompted autonomous turns, automatically provided present context, passive memory recall
method: static source inspection; no installation, hook execution, model calls or weather-service calls
evidence_classes: author_claim (README/doc text, not verified against code)

mechanism_trace: each Stop: read ONE line from io/inbox.jsonl by byte offset; if present, emit {decision:'block', reason:[time] #channel author: content} to re-inject it, advance+fsync offset, write .responded
next Stop: if .responded, FIRST checkInbox() and block(next) if a backlog line exists; only when no next line, write .restart and block IDLE_TICK
supervisor.js polls .restart every 2s, SIGTERMs claude, respawns after 2s (claude --model <m> --dangerously-skip-permissions <prompt>)
INTENDED (README/comment) result: one real message = one fresh session = clean context
sources.classification_correction: NOT an implementation guarantee of one-message-one-session: when .responded exists, a backlog line is delivered and blocked in the SAME session before .restart is written; fresh-session-per-message is README/comment INTENT
sources.idle_and_liveness: when elapsed < MIN_INTERVAL (HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL, default 60s) the code still can sleepSecs(15) then block(IDLE_TICK); the interval is a branch threshold, NOT proof of 60s model-call spacing; watchdog kills on stale .last-tick (WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT default 300s); orphan reaper on startup
sources.offset_semantics: offset advance is receipt-style consumption (write-on-read); it does NOT prove the model handled the line
sources.stop_continuation_caveat: blocking on Stop relies on CC's Stop continuation mechanism; the current CC Stop continuation cap (see docs/heartbeat-and-channels.md) makes the old unlimited-loop compatibility UNTESTED
sources.outbox_relay: relay/relay.js is an optional separate bridge polling io/outbox.jsonl and sending {action:'send',channelId,content} via discord.js (also typing/files)
sources.classification: external supervisor-driven unprompted turn; not CC-native heartbeat or MCP channel; intended stateless delivery, but backlog can share one session; idle ticks are intended for liveness, model silence untested
sources.author_claims_separated: README billing claim (-p/SDK credit bucket vs subscription) is an AUTHOR CLAIM; current billing is out of scope and not endorsed

sources.not_reviewed: whole backend, MCP server and daemon lifecycle

passive_recall.path: UserPromptSubmit -> scripts/recall.py; reads stdin prompt (also user_prompt), optional transcript multi-turn, calls client.recall, formats <hindsight_memories>...</hindsight_memories>, emits hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext
passive_recall.visibility: content is emitted for MODEL INPUT; additionalContext is hidden from the ordinary UI but is NOT thereby absent from the on-disk transcript (see docs/context-retention.md for persistence/cleanup)

budget_timeout.note: 45s is the hook PROCESS budget; 10s is the default single HTTP call timeout -- different layers, not inherently a conflict; README 12s is documentation drift; not runtime-aligned

duplicate_behavior.additional_banks: seen_banks skips a bank already recalled in recallAdditionalBanks; extra banks can make total elapsed differ from the single 10s call budget
duplicate_behavior.config_defaults: recallTypes='observation' / recallMinScores reflect INTENDED consolidated types, not tested repeated-result suppression
duplicate_behavior.hook_level_dedup: type='observation' is NOT hook-level dedup; no evidenced mechanism against re-injecting the same memory on every prompt
duplicate_behavior.confidence: inferred from config defaults + README, not tested

counterexample_distinction.session_start: AUTOMATIC context (passive): injects recent daily-log text as additionalContext (up to 2 most recent files, up to 40 lines each, <=1800 bytes) as cold-start context; it is RECENT HISTORY, not necessarily present state; not a search
counterexample_distinction.user_prompt_submit: USER-VISIBLE HINT: emits only systemMessage when prompt>=10 chars and memsearch available; no retrieval or memory content delivery. Official hooks contract describes systemMessage as a user-facing message, not additionalContext for the model.
counterexample_distinction.actual_recall: README describes model-invoked memory-recall skill (context: fork); skill body not read

sources.byte_cap_note: 1800 bytes is THIS script's own RECENT_MEMORY_MAX_BYTES cap; the adjoining comment about a ~2KB CC inline additionalContext truncation is an AUTHOR observation at that snapshot, NOT the current official CC limit; present live hook limits and the target build need their own evidence
sources.classification_rule: A user-visible capability hint is not passive retrieval or evidence of model context; SessionStart recent-log injection supplies automatic context; model-invoked skill recall is separately described by README.
sources.author_claims_separated: 3-layer progressive disclosure / fork is an AUTHOR DESCRIPTION; only shell evidence inspected

sources.declared_cc_version: 2.1.287+ (author README; author-tested Linux x64 2026-10-02; NOT verified this run)
sources.classification: TRANSFORMATION of already-supplied context (Mods prompt.attachment / prompt.context); NOT a producer of present state, NOT recall, NOT a wake
sources.input_surface: event exposes e.text (body) and origin.kind in {engine,hook,plugin}; no evidence of upstream request prefix/suffix; no channel adapter
sources.engine_origin_qualifier: origin.kind==='engine' means rendered by the engine, NOT that the body contains only Claude Code text; engine text can embed third-party originals (e.g. @-files, hook output, forwarded message text). Existing repo research (docs/current-state.md) establishes engine-generated messages may contain external originals, so roof-mod's origin filter does not imply the prose is engine-authored only.
sources.weather_location_coverage: absent in inspected files; recorded as missing, not substituted by a model-invoked weather tool
sources.side_note: gray-release switch tengu_plugin_hooks_modules gates loading of third-party hook modules, decided at process start

sources.mechanism: launchd StartInterval=3600 (hourly) -> ~/scripts/heartbeat.py -> independent Anthropic client API call -> illustrative fixed time/last-message prompt -> SPOKE:/SILENT: -> POST http://127.0.0.1:8795/chat/append (source:heartbeat) -> APNs push
sources.classification: application-level scheduled companion push; NOT CC-native heartbeat; not a periodic companion-process wake; no code executed
sources.author_claims_separated: real history, quiet-hours and dedupe are FURTHER SUGGESTIONS (not implemented); the fixed time/last-message prompt is ILLUSTRATIVE and does not represent the author's private production job

sources.platform: Kelivo client -> own Gateway (server.js) -> upstream LLM API; NOT a Claude Code plugin, NOT native CC compatible
sources.mechanism: wake_up.js self-schedules by DAY/NIGHT_CHECK_INTERVAL_MINUTES (10min/2h), shouldWake() by DAY/NIGHT_WAKE_AFTER_MINUTES (60/120min), reads enhanced_messages.json timeline, computes diff from last user time, builds wake prompt, POSTs TARGET_API_URL, sends Bark/ntfy push and attempts an outcome POST to the gateway; persistence unverified

weather_location.injection: formatted ## weather block injected into wake prompt via ${weatherContext}/${weather} placeholders

prompt_packaging.buildWakePrompt: priority wake_prompt.txt -> WAKE_PROMPT_TEMPLATE env -> built-in default; replaces ${currentTime}/${diffMinutes}/${weatherContext}/${weather}
prompt_packaging.request_assembly: SOURCE READING, not a runtime measurement: system = [wakePrompt, cleanSP]; user = recent-history text explicitly labeled not-live/user-did-not-message/background-autonomous-wake; POST temperature 0.8 top_p 0.95 stream false
prompt_packaging.retained_outcomes: runWakeUp ATTEMPTS to POST eventContent to GATEWAY_URL and catches write failure -- it does NOT directly/reliably write the local timeline; after a SUCCESSFUL model response it can record sent/silent/empty/diary-only/push-failed; an upstream model error throws BEFORE this stage so NOT every failure is retained; server.js unreviewed; optional [DIARY] saved to diary/YYYY-MM-DD.md

sources.classification: Kelivo/gateway wake runtime; weatherContext is mechanism-fetched present context (passive), not a model-invoked weather tool; NOT native CC compatibility

activity_gate_inspection.claim: Wake eligibility uses elapsed minutes from a timestamp parsed from user timeline content. These paths do not establish an explicit main-chat active/busy lock. HEARTBEAT_URL POST is runtime liveness reporting, separate from model wake execution.
